title: Las Escadas Rally
style: Hip-hop rap with soulful swagger and a bouncy mid-tempo groove; verse rides tight kick-snare bounce with callout cadences and elastic Spanish-English flow; pre-chorus opens space with claps, bass pulls, and harmony pads; chorus hits with chanty gang vocals, hook doubling, and short answer-back ad-libs. Rafa the rapper leads with gritty close-mic verses, stacked doubles on key rhymes, quick delay throws, and a few Spanish tag lines. Ear candy includes risers into the hook, reversed cymbal swells, and handclap accents. Mix is warm, punchy, and chest-level., rap, soul
